articles.topic: 日本語判定モデルの評価
articles.accessNote: Complete public article body captured as text. Author-reported measurements, not independently rerun. Code excerpts were read without executing them.
articles.facts: 13 fixed-revision models, 17 primary S1MB tasks, 8 complete under official rule. S1MB grouped 30/70 temperature scaling improves ECE/NLL in held-out S1MB but worsens some bench_ja tasks. Choice permutation compares original IDs; omitted failed pairs and no business data, latency or VRAM.

articles.title: サーバーが速くても Next.js の画面遷移が遅く感じる理由
articles.accessNote: Complete public article body captured as text. Author-reported measurements, not independently rerun. Code excerpts were read without executing them.
articles.facts: Browser needs RSC payload, not only JS. Traditional viewport prefetch differs between static and dynamic destinations, while Cache Components and 16.3 partialPrefetching reuse App Shell. Development and production differ; migration experience, no universal latency benchmark. Japanese adaptation in window.

articles.facts: Read decision columns as Row for all candidates, hydrate only selected IDs and restore selection order. A 31-candidate/limit-2 test checks <=3 loads and late eligible item precedence. Warm deploy observation near 0.12s vs 1.0–1.9s; long-term health not established by this measurement.
